response.sql: SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) AS excess_over_overall FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC LIMIT 10
